intro.en: Engine harnesses connect the ECU, protected power distribution, sensors, injectors, ignition components, throttle and air controls, pumps, valves, aftertreatment devices and the vehicle-side interface around the power unit. The category includes compact on-engine looms, engine-bay sub-harnesses, injector and ignition branches, sensor leads, transmission and aftertreatment branches, generator-set harnesses and complete engine-to-body assemblies.
intro.zh: 发动机线束连接 ECU、受保护配电、传感器、喷油器、点火部件、节气门与进气控制、泵、阀、后处理设备以及动力单元周边的车身侧接口。该小类覆盖紧凑型发动机本体线束、发动机舱分线束、喷油与点火分支、传感器引线、变速箱与后处理分支、发电机组线束及完整发动机到车身组件。

knowledge.en: An engine harness is a coordinated power, signal, communication and mechanical routing system, not a bundle copied from connector appearance. Engine family, controller, sensor and actuator set, firing order, transmission, emissions equipment, system voltage, thermal map, vibration, fluids, service route and vehicle interface determine the released design.
knowledge.zh: 发动机线束是一套协调供电、信号、通信与机械走线的系统，不能依据连接器外观简单复制。发动机家族、控制器、传感器与执行器组合、点火顺序、变速箱、排放设备、系统电压、热分布、振动、油液、维修路径和整车接口共同决定放行设计。

notes.en: Provide engine and vehicle or equipment identity; controller and calibration family; system voltage; connector and mating-part data; pin and circuit tables; sensor, injector, ignition, valve, motor and heater loads; CAN, LIN or other communication details; grounding and shielding intent; on-engine and body-side breakpoints; route photographs and datums; heat, vibration, oil, fuel, coolant, water and abrasion exposure; drawings or sample; labels; quantity; and required validation.
notes.zh: 请提供发动机及车辆或设备身份、控制器与标定家族、系统电压、连接器及对插件资料、针脚与回路表、传感器、喷油器、点火、阀、电机与加热器负载、CAN、LIN 或其他通信信息、接地与屏蔽意图、发动机本体和车身侧断开点、走线照片与基准、热、振动、机油、燃油、冷却液、水与磨损暴露、图纸或样品、标签、数量及所需验证。

delivery.en: Approved requirements become controlled drawings, pin and circuit tables, BOMs, cut lists, splice maps, branch datums, shielding and protection instructions, labels and test definitions. First articles are checked for mating, reach, clip position, engine installation, service access, electrical identity and agreed powered functions before repeat production. Harness revision remains linked to engine, controller, vehicle configuration, fixture and inspection records.
delivery.zh: 批准需求会转化为受控图纸、针脚与回路表、物料表、裁线表、接续图、分支基准、屏蔽与防护工艺、标签及测试定义。重复生产前检查首件的对插、可达、卡扣位置、发动机装配、维修空间、电气身份与约定上电功能；线束版本持续关联发动机、控制器、车辆配置、工装和检验记录。

introduction.en: Build the Engine Electrical System Around Real Heat, Motion and Signal Paths
introduction.zh: 围绕真实热区、运动与信号路径设计发动机电气系统

subtitle.en: Engine families, ECU power, sensors, actuators, thermal zones, sealing and controlled validation
subtitle.zh: 覆盖发动机家族、ECU 供电、传感器、执行器、热区、密封与受控验证

lead.en: Engine wiring brings unlike circuits into one compact and demanding installation. Reliable development starts by mapping every power source, controller, load, sensor, communication pair, ground, shield and mechanical support point.
lead.zh: 发动机布线把性质不同的回路集中在紧凑而严苛的安装空间中。可靠开发从绘制每个电源、控制器、负载、传感器、通信线对、接地、屏蔽与机械支撑点开始。

title.en: One category covers many cylinder layouts, fuels, controls and equipment duties
title.zh: 同一小类覆盖多种缸体布局、燃料、控制与设备任务

copy.en: Passenger and commercial gasoline engines, light and heavy diesel engines, hybrid range extenders, stationary generator sets and industrial or marine power units divide their electrical architecture differently. A project may use a single on-engine loom, separate injector and sensor branches, an aftertreatment sub-harness, a transmission interface or a complete engine-to-body assembly. Cylinder count, bank arrangement, induction system, emissions equipment, accessory drive and service sequence determine branch stations and disconnect boundaries.
copy.zh: 乘用与商用汽油机、轻型与重型柴油机、混合动力增程器、固定式发电机组以及工业或船用动力单元会采用不同电气架构。项目可以是一根发动机本体线束，也可以拆分喷油与传感分支、后处理分线束、变速箱接口或完整发动机到车身组件。缸数、缸列布局、进气系统、排放设备、附件驱动和维修顺序共同决定分支站位与断开边界。

copy.en: Engine code, controller and installed options matter more than outward similarity.
copy.zh: 发动机代码、控制器和安装选项比外观相似更重要。

copy.en: Disconnect points follow assembly, removal and field service reality.
copy.zh: 断开点服从装配、拆卸与现场维修实际。

title.en: Controller feeds, grounds and protected load circuits are engineered as complete loops
title.zh: 控制器供电、接地与受保护负载回路按完整闭环设计

copy.en: Battery feeds, switched ignition, keep-alive power, main relays, fuse outputs, ECU grounds, sensor grounds and actuator returns perform different jobs. Conductor size follows current, cranking voltage, route length, allowable voltage drop, ambient temperature, bundling and terminal limits. High-current loads such as heaters, pumps, motors and glow systems require coordinated protection and return paths. Ground splices and eyelets are located and prepared deliberately because voltage offset at a controller or sensor can create faults that continuity alone will not reveal.
copy.zh: 蓄电池供电、点火开关电源、保持电源、主继电器、保险输出、ECU 接地、传感器地与执行器回流承担不同任务。导体截面服从电流、起动电压、路径长度、允许压降、环境温度、成束和端子限制。加热器、泵、电机与预热系统等大电流负载需要协调保护与回流路径；控制器或传感器上的接地偏移可能产生导通检查无法发现的故障，因此接地接续与搭铁端子的站位和表面处理必须明确。

copy.en: Controller, sensor and heavy-load circuits retain their intended protection and return.
copy.zh: 控制器、传感器与大负载回路保持各自规定的保护和回流。

copy.en: Supply and ground resistance both affect operating margin.
copy.zh: 供电与接地电阻都会影响工作余量。

title.en: Timing, pressure, temperature and composition signals need controlled references and routing
title.zh: 正时、压力、温度与成分信号需要受控参考和走线

copy.en: Crankshaft and camshaft position, manifold and rail pressure, air mass, throttle position, coolant and oil temperature, knock, oxygen, exhaust temperature and differential-pressure sensing can combine analogue, frequency, digital and biased circuits. Reference voltage, sensor ground, pull-up strategy, shield termination, twist construction and separation from injectors, ignition and motors follow controller documentation. Connector indexing, branch identity and sensor-side strain relief help prevent crossed sensors and intermittent faults during service.
copy.zh: 曲轴与凸轮轴位置、歧管与油轨压力、空气流量、节气门位置、冷却液与机油温度、爆震、氧、排气温度及差压感知可能同时包含模拟、频率、数字和偏置回路。参考电压、传感器地、上拉策略、屏蔽端接、绞合结构以及与喷油、点火和电机回路的隔离服从控制器资料；连接器防错、分支身份与传感器端应力缓解有助于避免传感器错接和维修后的间歇故障。

copy.en: Sensor returns are not casually shared with noisy load grounds.
copy.zh: 传感器回流不能随意与噪声负载接地共用。

copy.en: Crank and cam paths follow approved shielding, twist and routing intent.
copy.zh: 曲轴与凸轮轴路径服从批准的屏蔽、绞合与走线意图。

title.en: Fast switching loads place different demands on wire, terminals and electromagnetic control
title.zh: 快速开关负载对线材、端子与电磁控制提出不同要求

copy.en: Injectors, ignition coils, electronic throttle bodies, idle and boost controls, variable valve timing solenoids, EGR valves, fuel metering devices, pumps, fans and heaters can carry very different currents and switching waveforms. The harness must preserve firing and cylinder order, polarity, shared feeds, individual control returns and any diagnostic feedback. Branch length, conductor symmetry, terminal resistance, thermal exposure and distance from sensitive circuits are reviewed so that an apparently correct point-to-point loom does not introduce timing, voltage-drop or interference problems.
copy.zh: 喷油器、点火线圈、电子节气门、怠速与增压控制、可变气门正时电磁阀、EGR 阀、燃油计量装置、泵、风扇与加热器的电流和开关波形差异很大。线束必须保持点火与气缸顺序、极性、共用供电、独立控制回流及诊断反馈。分支长度、导体对称、端子电阻、热暴露和与敏感回路的距离均需审核，避免点对点看似正确的线束引入时序、压降或干扰问题。

copy.en: Labels, lengths and connector keying reinforce the released firing map.
copy.zh: 标签、长度与连接器防错共同强化放行点火映射。

copy.en: Injector, coil and motor routes are reviewed against sensitive signals.
copy.zh: 喷油、点火线圈与电机路径需结合敏感信号审核。

title.en: Breakpoints must support installation, movement, diagnosis and complete powertrain service
title.zh: 断开点要同时支持装配、运动、诊断与完整动力总成维修

copy.en: The engine loom may meet a body, dash, transmission, chassis or aftertreatment harness through one or several bulk connectors. Interfaces carry power, grounds, starting and charging circuits, networks, analogue signals and equipment controls. We define mating face, keying, pin map, shielding continuity, backshell direction, clamp location and service reach. Engine roll, mount movement, assembly drop-in and powertrain removal are checked so that the interface is neither over-constrained nor left with an unsupported loop.
copy.zh: 发动机线束可能通过一个或多个总接口连接车身、仪表、变速箱、底盘或后处理线束，接口承载电源、接地、起动与充电、网络、模拟信号及设备控制。需要明确对插面、防错、针脚、屏蔽连续性、尾壳方向、夹持位置和维修可达；同时检查发动机摆动、悬置运动、总成落装与动力总成拆卸，避免接口过度约束或留下无支撑余环。

copy.en: Wire-side and mating-face views are identified to prevent mirrored pin maps.
copy.zh: 明确进线侧与对插面视图，避免针脚镜像。

copy.en: Slack and clamps follow mount travel, not only the static position.
copy.zh: 余量与夹持服从悬置行程，而不只看静止位置。

title.en: Material and route decisions follow local heat sources and exposure duration
title.zh: 材料与走线决策服从局部热源和暴露持续时间

copy.en: Exhaust manifolds, turbochargers, EGR systems, cylinder heads, diesel aftertreatment and regeneration hardware can create severe radiant and conducted heat beside cooler intake and body zones. Air temperature alone is not enough to define risk. Distance, view factor, heat soak after shutdown, airflow, clip material, sleeve transition and contact with hot metal all matter. High-temperature wire, heat-reflective sleeve, glass braid, formed shield or stand-off support is applied by the mapped zone, while connectors and splices are moved away whenever routing permits.
copy.zh: 排气歧管、涡轮增压器、EGR 系统、气缸盖、柴油后处理与再生硬件会在较冷的进气和车身区域旁形成强烈辐射热与传导热。仅用空气温度不足以定义风险，距离、视角、停机热浸、气流、卡扣材料、套管过渡以及与热金属接触都很重要。耐高温线、反射隔热套、玻纤编织、成形隔热罩或离位支撑依据热区图配置，并在走线允许时把连接器与接续点移离高温区域。

copy.en: Peak exposure may occur after load or after engine shutdown.
copy.zh: 峰值暴露可能出现在高负荷之后或发动机停机之后。

copy.en: Sleeve ends and clamp points must not create new rub or bend concentrations.
copy.zh: 套管端部与夹持点不能形成新的摩擦或弯折集中。

title.en: Branch mass, clamp spacing and bend direction control fatigue around the engine
title.zh: 分支重量、夹持间距与弯曲方向共同控制发动机周边疲劳

copy.en: Engine vibration, combustion order, accessory motion and vehicle inputs act on wire exits, splices, clips and connector latches. A heavy branch can load a small sensor connector even when the wire itself is flexible. Routes use controlled service loops, suitable clip spacing, abrasion protection and gradual transitions between stiff and flexible coverings. Unsupported mass, resonance, sharp brackets and movement between engine-mounted and body-mounted points are reviewed through the real operating envelope.
copy.zh: 发动机振动、燃烧顺序、附件运动与车辆输入会作用于出线、接续、卡扣和连接器锁止。即使线材柔软，较重分支也可能对小型传感器接口施加载荷。走线采用受控维修余环、合适卡扣间距、耐磨防护以及刚柔覆盖之间的渐变过渡；无支撑重量、共振、锐利支架及发动机固定点与车身固定点之间的相对运动都要结合真实运行包络审核。

copy.en: Harness mass is carried by the route, not by terminal retention.
copy.zh: 线束重量由走线支撑，而不是由端子保持力承担。

copy.en: Coverings and boots taper movement away from crimp and splice zones.
copy.zh: 覆盖与护套把运动逐步移离压接和接续区域。

title.en: Connector sealing and splice protection must match each local contaminant path
title.zh: 连接器密封与接续防护必须匹配各局部污染路径

copy.en: Engine oil, fuel vapour, coolant, cleaning chemicals, road spray and water can reach different zones by splash, gravity, pressure, condensation or capillary travel. Housing, terminal, wire seal, cavity plug, secondary lock, mating part and cable exit must form one compatible system. Splices are positioned and protected for their actual exposure, branch coverings are drained where needed, and upward-facing cavities or liquid traps are avoided. A sealed connector alone does not make the complete loom fluid-proof.
copy.zh: 机油、燃油蒸气、冷却液、清洗化学品、道路飞溅与水可能通过飞溅、重力、压力、冷凝或毛细路径进入不同区域。壳体、端子、线封、堵头、二次锁、对插件与出线必须构成相容体系；接续点依据真实暴露选址和防护，分支覆盖层在需要时排水，并避免孔腔朝上与积液。单独一个密封连接器不能让整根线束自动耐受所有液体。

copy.en: Terminal, seal, cavity and cable range are released together.
copy.zh: 端子、线封、孔位与线缆范围一并放行。

copy.en: Splices and cable ends are reviewed for fluid migration toward electronics.
copy.zh: 接续与线缆端部需审核液体向电子设备迁移的风险。

kicker.zh: 线材、标准件、参考标准与屏蔽

title.en: Every circuit receives a defined wire, terminal, seal and connector system for its real duty
title.zh: 每条回路都按真实任务定义线材、端子、线封与连接器系统

copy.en: An engine harness can combine thin-wall automotive primary wire, high-temperature cable, twisted CAN or LIN pairs, shielded crankshaft and camshaft sensor cable, coaxial leads and larger starter, alternator or heater conductors. Common project vocabularies include sealed ECU connectors, injector connectors, ignition-coil plugs, oxygen-sensor connectors, Deutsch DT, DTM and DTP families, TE AMP Superseal and HDSCS, Aptiv Metri-Pack and GT, Molex MX150 and MX123, plus customer-specified Yazaki or Sumitomo systems. Names identify a family, not automatic interchangeability: housing key, terminal series, plating, seal range, cavity plug, secondary lock and mating component are checked together. Depending on vehicle class and customer specification, engineering may reference ISO 19642-3 and ISO 19642-7 automotive cables, SAE J1128 low-voltage primary cable, ISO 8092-2:2023 connector performance, ISO 16750-3, ISO 16750-4 and ISO 16750-5 environmental loads, and IPC/WHMA-A-620 workmanship criteria. The applicable edition, class, test method and acceptance limit must be agreed for the project; listing a standard here does not claim blanket certification.
copy.zh: 发动机线束可能同时使用薄壁汽车低压线、耐高温电缆、CAN 或 LIN 双绞线、曲轴与凸轮轴传感器屏蔽线、同轴引线，以及用于起动机、发电机或加热器的大截面导体。项目中常见的标准件与搜索名称包括密封 ECU 连接器、喷油器插头、点火线圈插头、氧传感器连接器、Deutsch DT、DTM、DTP 系列、TE AMP Superseal 与 HDSCS、Aptiv Metri-Pack 与 GT、Molex MX150 与 MX123，以及客户指定的矢崎或住友连接器系统。名称只能识别系列，不能证明直接互换，壳体防错、端子系列、镀层、线封范围、堵头、二次锁与对插件必须成套核对。依据车型与客户规范，工程可参考 ISO 19642-3 与 ISO 19642-7 汽车电缆、SAE J1128 低压初级电缆、ISO 8092-2:2023 车载线束连接器性能、ISO 16750-3、ISO 16750-4、ISO 16750-5 环境负荷，以及 IPC/WHMA-A-620 线缆与线束组件工艺验收准则。具体版本、等级、试验方法与判定限值必须随项目确认；页面列出标准不等于宣称所有产品已获得该标准认证。

copy.en: Wire size and insulation diameter, terminal, seal, cavity, connector lock and mating contact remain compatible.
copy.zh: 线径与绝缘外径、端子、线封、孔位、连接器锁止及对插接触件保持相容。

title.zh: 定义数据对与屏蔽意图

copy.en: Twist lay, impedance-sensitive construction, shield coverage, drain wire, termination end and grounding point follow the controller and EMC design.
copy.zh: 绞距、阻抗敏感结构、屏蔽覆盖、排流线、端接端与接地点服从控制器及 EMC 设计。

title.en: Existing looms can guide development without copying damage, repairs or hidden assumptions
title.zh: 现有线束可指导开发，但不能复制损伤、维修或隐藏假设

copy.en: A sample can reveal connector family, branch stations, clips, coverings, labels and point-to-point circuits. It can also contain brittle insulation, heat damage, oil swelling, broken locks, repairs, swapped connectors or option-specific wiring. We record sample condition, trace circuits, identify the engine and controller, compare related variants and isolate unknown functions. Approved corrections and substitutions become controlled drawing revisions before a first article is installed and reviewed with representative equipment.
copy.zh: 样品能够呈现连接器家族、分支站位、卡扣、覆盖、标签与点对点回路，也可能带有绝缘脆化、热损伤、油液膨胀、锁止破坏、维修、接口调换或选装专用布线。我们记录样品状态、追踪回路、识别发动机与控制器、对照相关变型并隔离未知功能；批准修正与替代在首件安装并结合代表性设备审核前转化为受控图纸版本。

copy.en: Damage and workshop repairs are documented rather than reproduced.
copy.zh: 损伤与维修痕迹被记录，而不是被复制。

copy.en: Cylinder count, emissions level, transmission and options retain distinct identities.
copy.zh: 缸数、排放阶段、变速箱与选装保持独立身份。

title.en: Repeatability depends on staged inspection and clearly separated evidence levels
title.zh: 重复性依赖分段检查与清晰区分的证据层级

copy.en: Released drawings, circuit and pin tables, BOMs, cut lists, splice maps, form-board datums, work instructions and test definitions control production. Wire preparation, seal loading, crimping, splicing, connector insertion, secondary locks, coverings, clips and labels receive checks before hidden. Routine inspection can verify material identity, dimensions, cavity population, continuity, shorts and workmanship. Pull, resistance, voltage drop, insulation, sealing, thermal, vibration or flex tests are added only against approved methods and limits. Powered engine or simulator checks separately confirm the agreed inputs, outputs, communication and diagnostic behaviour.
copy.zh: 放行图纸、回路与针脚表、物料表、裁线表、接续图、布线板基准、作业指导及测试定义共同控制生产。剥线、穿线封、压接、接续、插壳、二次锁、覆盖、卡扣和标签在被遮蔽前接受检查。常规检验可核对物料身份、尺寸、装针、导通、短路与工艺；拉力、电阻、压降、绝缘、密封、温度、振动或弯折测试仅按批准方法和限值增加，上电发动机或模拟器检查则单独确认约定输入、输出、通信和诊断行为。

copy.en: Crimps, seals and splices are accepted before final covering.
copy.zh: 压接、线封与接续在最终覆盖前完成验收。

copy.en: Continuity, bench function and complete-engine validation are reported separately.
copy.zh: 导通、台架功能与完整发动机验证分别报告。

q.en: Is an engine harness a universal product?
q.zh: 发动机线束是通用产品吗？

a.en: No. It is a broad family of on-engine, injector, ignition, sensor, aftertreatment, transmission and body-interface assemblies. Engine, controller, emissions equipment, vehicle configuration and route determine the released version.
a.zh: 不是。它是发动机本体、喷油、点火、传感、后处理、变速箱及车身接口组件组成的广泛家族，发动机、控制器、排放设备、车辆配置与走线共同决定放行版本。

q.en: Can a matching connector prove that two engine harnesses are compatible?
q.zh: 连接器能插合就能证明两根发动机线束兼容吗？

a.en: No. Keying does not prove pin assignment, terminal rating, cylinder order, reference ground, shielding, communication, load current or controller compatibility. These must be verified against the actual system.
a.zh: 不能。防错不能证明针脚定义、端子额定值、气缸顺序、参考接地、屏蔽、通信、负载电流或控制器兼容性，必须结合真实系统核对。

q.en: Can you build gasoline, diesel and industrial engine harnesses?
q.zh: 可以制作汽油机、柴油机和工业发动机线束吗？

a.en: Yes, when the engine, controller, circuit information, interfaces, environment and validation requirements are defined. Each project is reviewed for its actual fuel system, ignition or injection, aftertreatment, voltage and equipment duty.
a.zh: 可以，但需要明确发动机、控制器、回路信息、接口、环境和验证要求。每个项目都按真实燃油系统、点火或喷射、后处理、电压与设备任务审核。

q.en: Does high-temperature sleeve make any wire suitable beside a turbocharger?
q.zh: 加耐高温套管就能让任何线材用于涡轮旁边吗？

a.en: No. Base wire, connector, seal, splice, sleeve, support, distance, radiant heat, heat soak and exposure duration must be reviewed together. Routing away from the source is preferred where possible.
a.zh: 不能。基础线材、连接器、线封、接续、套管、支撑、距离、辐射热、热浸与暴露时间必须一起审核，能够避开热源时应优先优化走线。

q.en: Can an old or damaged engine loom be used for replacement development?
q.zh: 可以依据旧的或损坏的发动机线束开发替换件吗？

a.en: Yes, as one evidence source. Heat damage, brittle insulation, oil exposure, repairs, missing parts and vehicle-option differences still need review against the engine, controller and circuit data before release.
a.zh: 可以把旧样作为一类证据，但热损伤、绝缘脆化、油液暴露、维修、缺失部件及车辆选装差异仍需结合发动机、控制器和回路资料审核后才能放行。

q.en: What should be provided for quotation and sampling?
q.zh: 报价与打样需要提供什么？

a.en: Send engine and equipment identity, controller, voltage, connector and pin data, sensor and actuator list, load and protection information, communication and shielding requirements, route photographs, branch dimensions, thermal and fluid exposure, drawings or sample, labels, quantity and required validation.
a.zh: 请提供发动机与设备身份、控制器、电压、连接器与针脚资料、传感器和执行器清单、负载与保护信息、通信与屏蔽要求、走线照片、分支尺寸、热与油液暴露、图纸或样品、标签、数量和所需验证。
